product_metadata.title: DII Southwest Colby Collection Tabletop, Table Runner, 15x72, Dark Brown/Stone
features: 15x72" TABLE RUNNER - Fits table that seat 4-6 people
EASY TO CLEAN - 100% Cotton. Machine washable. To minimize the shrinkage, tumble dry low, remove just prior to being completely dry.
TIMELESS DESIGN - Like a favorite knit sweater, the runner has lots of texture and full of detail. Fringed edges have a casual look that works with any style of dishes.
HIGH QUALITY HEAVY WEIGHT TABLE RUNNER - Perfect for everyday use, holidays, catering, special occasions, dinners, brunches, family gathering, and more.
THE TABLE RUNNER YOU'LL LOVE - Also great for entry way tables, coffee tables, dining tables, or other surfaces of your home.
description: DII provides decorative, fun and functional home decor and textiles. DII Braided Cotton Table Runners are a great way to style your table for dinner parties, weddings, or other elegant events on a budget. The modern, chic look is sure to catch the eyes of your guests, adds bohemian flair and dimension to the table. They are also great for entry way tables, coffee tables, dining tables, or other surfaces of your home. DII offers delightful home products including matching cloth napkins, napkin rings, placemats and tablecloths. Click the DII link at the top of the page to explore our collections.

details.Care instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Do not use bleach or fabric softeners. Tumble dry low. Do not iron. Wash before first use.
